headline: HAPPY BIRTHDAY

message_pool.text: Wishing you good health, happiness, and many more successful voyages ahead.
Fair winds, calm seas, good health, and another year of great adventures!
From everyone at 953 C. Aragon, wishing you a fantastic birthday!
Another year, another voyage around the sun. Happy birthday!
Good health, good company, and many more successful voyages ahead.
Wishing you a wonderful birthday filled with happiness and great memories.
